lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 121, for issue 117, which runs CI's verify tests three at a time.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one twenty-one, for issue one seventeen, which runs C I's verify tests three at a time.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what the PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
First, the runner lists the tests: the smoke test, then each verify script. Misnamed scripts are recorded, not run.
It keeps up to three tests running, and checks each one against the budget before it starts.
Each test still runs alone, with its own virtual screen, D-Bus session and home folder.
As each test ends, the results file is rewritten in the same order a serial run would give.
Locally, the build-verify agent now starts the suite in the background, with a 35-minute timeout.
lines.say: Locally, the build verify agent now starts the suite in the background, with a thirty-five minute timeout.

lines.caption: It waits for the completion notice, then reports each test's result and the exit code.
lines.say: It waits for the completion notice, then reports each test's result and the exit code.

lines.caption: On PR 116 the tests took about 13 minutes one after another, and a local run was cut off at 10.
lines.say: On pull request one sixteen the tests took about thirteen minutes one after another, and a local run was cut off at ten.

lines.caption: The key fact: each test already had its own sandbox, so only the runner needed a pool.
Step 1: the smoke test comes first, then the scripts in name order.
Step 2: the budget of 1500 seconds now counts real time since the run began.
lines.say: Step 2: the budget of fifteen hundred seconds now counts real time since the run began.

lines.caption: Step 3: each test writes its result to its own file, and its process id to another.
Step 4: the results come out in serial order, so the shot numbers don't change.
Step 5: the agent's background run also serves the visual-verify skill's capture.
lines.say: Step 5: the agent's background run also serves the visual verify skill's capture.

lines.caption: Step 6: it never waits with a foreground sleep, which the Bash tool would cut off.
Tests finish in any order, but the results keep the serial order.
If the run is stopped, an exit trap kills every running test and keeps the finished results.
JOBS sets how many run at once. Setting it to 1 runs them one at a time, as before.
lines.say: Jobs sets how many run at once. Setting it to one runs them one at a time, as before.

lines.caption: The PR changes the runner script, the build-verify agent, the visual-verify skill and CLAUDE.md, and adds this explainer.
lines.say: The PR changes the runner script, the build verify agent, the visual verify skill and CLAUDE.md, and adds this explainer.

lines.caption: To undo it, run one test at a time again, or revert the PR.
Part 2. How it was built and verified: mock tests and a full run in a cloud container. CI's run is still to come.
lines.say: Part 2. How it was built and verified: mock tests and a full run in a cloud container. C I's run is still to come.

lines.caption: The time to beat is PR 116's serial run: about 13 minutes on CI.
lines.say: The time to beat is pull request one sixteen's serial run: about thirteen minutes on C I.

lines.caption: The new runner keeps the old one's result order and budget rule.
A mock run with stubbed tests kept the serial order, and skipped a test that could overrun the budget.
Stopped partway, it exited 143 and left no test running. A JOBS of zero was refused.
lines.say: Stopped partway, it exited one forty-three and left no test running. A jobs of zero was refused.

lines.caption: In a cloud container, all 20 tests passed in 333 seconds, before the CI review fixes.
lines.say: In a cloud container, all twenty tests passed in three hundred thirty-three seconds, before the C I review fixes.

lines.caption: That run was under 10 minutes, so a longer local run wasn't shown.
lines.say: That run was under ten minutes, so a longer local run wasn't shown.

lines.caption: No Thunar screenshots: the PR changes only CI and agent files.
The two times come from different machines, so they don't measure the speed-up yet.
A local review before the first push found five issues and fixed three.
S1: nothing stopped running tests if the run was killed. The exit trap fixes that.
lines.say: S one: nothing stopped running tests if the run was killed. The exit trap fixes that.

lines.caption: S2: three workers on four processors might make the tests flaky. Only CI can show it.
lines.say: S two: three workers on four processors might make the tests flaky. Only C I can show it.

lines.caption: CI's review found ten findings, and all but R6 were fixed.
lines.say: C I's review found ten findings, and all but R six were fixed.

lines.caption: Results are kept as each test ends, and the exit trap stops every test cleanly.
The agent's run sets its log folder and waits with a timeout, and JOBS must be a positive number.
lines.say: The agent's run sets its log folder and waits with a timeout, and jobs must be a positive number.

lines.caption: R6, the load worry, stays open until CI's verify run on this PR.
lines.say: R six, the load worry, stays open until C I's verify run on this pull request.

lines.caption: CI's verify run on PR 121 shows whether three workers hold up, and how much time they save.
lines.say: C I's verify run on pull request one twenty-one shows whether three workers hold up, and how much time they save.

lines.caption: It also runs the review fixes on the full suite, and its shots are then audited.
A local run longer than 10 minutes waits for the suite to grow.
lines.say: A local run longer than ten minutes waits for the suite to grow.

lines.caption: Links to the PR, the issue and the serial reference are at the end of Part 2.
Part 3. What comes later: no open issue depends on 117, so next is CI's run on this PR.
lines.say: Part 3. What comes later: no open issue depends on one seventeen, so next is C I's run on this pull request.

lines.caption: This PR runs the tests three at a time.
Next, CI's verify run settles R6 and shows the time saved.
lines.say: Next, C I's verify run settles R six and shows the time saved.

lines.caption: After that, each new feature script costs the budget less.
Running only changed scripts was left out on purpose, so older features stay tested.
In short: PR 121 runs verify three tests at a time, and local runs finish in the background.
lines.say: In short: pull request one twenty-one runs verify three tests at a time, and local runs finish in the background.
